---
title: "Agentic AI for Researchers"
---

A working guide to doing research with an AI agent, for researchers rather than developers.

How to run an agent, how to teach it your conventions, how to use it at each stage of a paper (organization, literature, data, analysis, verification, writing, reproducibility), and the judgment that keeps it safe. It assumes the Claude or Codex app, git, and the language you already use.
